admission.capacityNote: 27 admitted from 131 applicants in 2025, according to The Animation Workshop.

selection.description: The portfolio is assessed on how well it meets the programme's portfolio requirements, skill level in the relevant categories, creative vision, and how clearly the work is curated and presented.
A 4-hour individual online test of small drawing assignments, testing time management, following directions, and drawing and storytelling skills.
A 20 to 25 minute interview with two or three faculty members, in person in Viborg (or online by arrangement), about motivation, the test and portfolio, and past experience.

requirements.label: An IB Diploma, or DP Course Results with at least 18 points, grade 3 in all six subjects and three of them at HL

officialWording.text: IB-elever uden IB Diploma, men med mindst 18 point (Diploma Programme (DP) Course Results), har adgang til videregående uddannelser i Danmark på lige vilkår med ansøgere med den 2-årige hf-eksamen uden overbygning. Det kræver, at alle 6 IB-fag (3 HL-fag og 3 SL- eller 4 HL-fag og 2 SL-fag) er bestået med mindst karakteren 3. Det betyder, at de har adgang til at søge optagelse på erhvervsakademi- og professionsbacheloruddannelser gennem kvote 1 og 2.

requirements.note: The rule is national, not this institution's. The Danish Agency for Higher Education and Science treats DP Course Results of at least 18 points, with grade 3 or more in all six subjects and three at HL, like a two-year hf without overbygning, which gives access to erhvervsakademi and professionsbachelor programmes through quota 1 and quota 2. This is a professionsbachelor programme, which the Agency names directly. The institution's own page names the IB but says nothing about Course Results, so a Course candidate should confirm with admissions in writing. The award does not waive the subject requirements below.

officialWording.text: All applicants (including native English speakers) must document English proficiency. It must be equivalent to a Danish B-level with a minimum weighted grade point average score of 2.0 on the Danish grading scale. [...] If your upper secondary qualification does not meet the required level and scores, you must take an English proficiency test.

requirements.label: A portfolio, cover letter and video introduction, uploaded by 15 March

officialWording.text: Your portfolio must contain: A filled in official cover letter; An active link to your video introduction, which serves as a motivational letter; Examples of your work fulfilling the requirements for the programme.
